paper.title_en: Whispers of Supergravity in Gravitational Wave Backgrounds: Determining the Gravitino Mass from Cosmic Thermal History
paper.abstract_en: Gravitino masses above the electroweak scale provide the simplest solution to the gravitino problem, but such large mass scales lie far beyond the reach of collider experiments. We show that the stochastic gravitational wave background offers a direct probe of this otherwise inaccessible regime. Despite decaying before Big-Bang Nucleosynthesis (BBN), these gravitinos naturally generate a period of early matter domination in the early universe. This non-standard epoch leaves a characteristic imprint on any primordial gravitational wave background, characterised by two frequencies corresponding to the onset and end of this phase. We demonstrate that, when early matter domination occurs while the gravitational-wave background is freely propagating, its spectral features enable the direct inference of both the gravitino mass and initial abundance, while more generally, even when the background is sourced during the early matter-dominated epoch, the gravitino mass can still be determined. Future gravitational wave observatories span a vast frequency range, enabling sensitivity to gravitino masses from the BBN bound of $\mathcal{O}(100) \text{TeV}$ up to $\mathcal{O}(10^{10}) \text{TeV}$. Already, the signal reported by NANOGrav, if primordial in origin, offers a potential probe of gravitino masses in the range $500$-$10^4 \text{TeV}$. Gravitational wave observables therefore probe an enormous region of parameter space, far beyond the reach of collider experiments. We are entering an era in which supergravity can be probed through gravitational wave backgrounds alongside collider experiments.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文将随机引力波背景作为探测超电弱能标gravitino质量的直接窗口，论证早期物质主导阶段在原始引力波谱上留下由起始与结束两个频率表征的特征印记，并给出未来观测站及NANOGrav信号对gravitino质量的探测范围，与PTA方向高度相关且理论深度较高。
decision.title_zh: 引力波背景中的超引力低语：从宇宙热历史确定gravitino质量
decision.abstract_zh: 超电弱能标以上的gravitino质量给出了gravitino问题的最简单解决方案，但如此大的质量尺度远在对撞机实验的可及范围之外。我们表明，随机引力波背景为这一原本不可及的区间提供了直接探针。尽管这些gravitino在太初核合成（BBN）之前就已衰变，它们自然地在早期宇宙中产生了一段早期物质主导时期。这一非标准阶段会在任何原始引力波背景上留下特征印记，其标志为对应于该阶段开始与结束的两个频率。我们证明，当早期物质主导发生时引力波背景正处于自由传播状态时，其谱特征使得能够直接推断出gravitino质量和初始丰度；而更一般地，即使背景是在早期物质主导时期被产生的，gravitino质量仍然可以被确定。未来的引力波天文台覆盖极宽的频率范围，使得对gravitino质量的灵敏度从BBN下限$\mathcal{O}(100) \text{TeV}$直到$\mathcal{O}(10^{10}) \text{TeV}$。NANOGrav已经报告的信号，若其起源为原初的，则已经为$500$-$10^4 \text{TeV}$范围内的gravitino质量提供了潜在探针。因此，引力波观测量探测了巨大的参数空间区域，远超对撞机实验的可及范围。我们正在进入一个可以通过引力波背景与对撞机实验一同探测超引力的时代。
